status: PROVED at the stated direct-simulation scope, using the accepted all-clock physical capacity upper bound

physical_family.fixed_parameter: Choose an admissible fixed integer b>=6 and u=2^(-2b). theta=b log 2.
physical_family.lattice: ell_k=D*2^k, n_k=D^2*4^k, for a fixed sufficiently large integer D with D/(2b log 2)>C; explicitly list the n_k sites.
physical_family.volume: For all sufficiently large k, C R_k<ell_k<=R_k^p for any fixed p>1, with all original capacity hypotheses retained.
physical_family.core_cutoff: For example r_k=b+4k+4 ceil(log2(D+1)); for sufficiently large k, 1<=r_k<=R_k, r_k<ell_k/4 and eta_r<1/2.
physical_family.normalization: One proposal clock of rate one per physical site

attempted_mechanism.blocks: Any fixed explicitly listed family of regions, each supplied with a vertex ordering and exact conditional Gibbs resampling
attempted_mechanism.clocks: Arbitrary nonnegative rational auxiliary rates; original physical clocks are retained
attempted_mechanism.efficiency_hypothesis: Complete description polynomial in R_k and Gamma_max polynomial in R_k, e.g. all cutwidths O(log n_k) at fixed u

accepted_capacity_premise: For every kappa>0, C_kappa/Z_A<=a_cap+b_cap*kappa, with the full explicit source expression recorded in RESEARCH_REPORT.txt; a_cap,b_cap have exponentially small weak-field bounds under the retained conditions.
proved_bounds: With d0=u^6/(1+u^6), P(hit within J changing updates)<=min(1,(2e*Gamma_max*a_cap/d0)*(J+log(1/zeta))+e*b_cap+zeta)
exact_failed_claim: Exactly normalized conditional updates on such blocks, possibly with arbitrarily inflated auxiliary clocks or null-update skipping, by themselves witness the original nucleation transition with constant probability using polynomial direct-simulation work.
scope: A lower bound for witnessing by the specified direct block simulation, not a lower bound for predicting the mean/CDF, arbitrary dynamics, weighted computation, importance sampling, splitting, or other representations.
retained_earlier_failure_objects: Unchanged in Nucleation_Law_20261107.zip and earlier archives.
